description: This file defines a Java interface 'NamespaceCommand' for managing namespace-related commands within a JSON-based command framework. It includes nested classes that specify JSON field definitions, notably the 'NAMESPACE' field, used to identify the target namespace in JSON representations.

classes.name: NamespaceCommand
classes.description: An interface defining commands for managing a specific namespace, extending Command and WithNamespace, with a nested static class for JSON field definitions.

classes.name: NamespaceCommand.JsonFields
classes.description: An abstract class extending Command.JsonFields that defines a JSON field 'NAMESPACE' used in JSON representations of namespace commands.

methods.name: JsonFields.NAMESPACE
methods.description: A static final JSON field definition for the 'namespace' field, specifying its name, type, and supported schema versions.
